comment: QGroundControl Fly View actions for the mini4pro bridge — the bottom auxiliary lamp.
To install: QGC -> Fly View Settings -> 'Fly View Actions File', point it at this file.
The buttons then appear behind the Fly View's additional-actions button. No QGC build,
no patch, no plugin: QGC reads this file at startup (MavlinkActionManager.cc) and sends
mavCmd 31010 is MAV_CMD_USER_1, which MAVLink reserves for exactly this. There is no
standard command for a lamp on an airframe QGC believes is a PX4 quadcopter, and taking
a standard id would collide with whatever that id comes to mean.
param1: 0 AUTO, 1 ON, 2 OFF, 3 BEACON. Anything else is refused by the bridge rather
than clamped, because DJI's own enum has an UNKNOWN member and a lenient mapping would
ask the aircraft for a mode nobody chose.
BEACON is deliberately not given a button. It strobes, which alternates the camera's
exposure frame to frame and is the worst possible mode for anything looking at video.
It remains reachable by editing this file, by whoever wants it and knows why.

actions.label: Light On
actions.description: Force the bottom auxiliary lamp on. It lights the ground close in, for the downward vision sensors — whether it helps the camera see a tag at height is unmeasured.

actions.label: Light Off
actions.description: Force the bottom auxiliary lamp off.

actions.label: Light Auto
actions.description: Hand the lamp back to the aircraft, which turns it on near the ground for the landing sensors. This is the factory behaviour and the state to leave it in.
